description: Administration des Ponts et Chaussées: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration des Ponts et Chaussées. Coverage: Administration des Ponts et Chaussées. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PCH : Les futurs chantiers pistes cyclables; PCH : Les chantiers actuels des pistes cyclables; Point-nœuds sur le réseau cyclable national au Luxembourg. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
